cand.title: GDPM 2027: 10th International Workshop on Grapevine Downy and Powdery Mildews

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: No named 2027 accommodation buyer or organizer with purchasing responsibility was verified. Official enquiry channel: info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch. Two verified institutional referral candidates are Katia Gindro, head of Agroscope Mycology, and Dr Pierre-Henri Dubuis, Agroscope Mycology at Changins and a previous GDPM contributor. Their scientific/institutional relevance is established; their involvement in organizing GDPM 2027 and hotel-contract authority are not.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 13–16 July 2027, Nyon, Switzerland. These are workshop activity dates, not the 5 October 2026 announcement date. Both the French Agroscope announcement and the official event website agree; dates fall within the requested horizon.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: a Founex hotel in the Nyon / La Côte corridor is geographically relevant for accommodation supporting the Changins event. This is a research-campus scientific meeting, not a resort retreat or downtown-Geneva mega-convention. YOTEL should pursue only an additional lodging role with transport to Changins, not displacement of the announced workshop venue. Historic attendance of 30 in 2017, approximately 75 in 2014 and 98 in 2010 suggests a modest group enquiry could be proportionate, but these are not a 2027 forecast or room demand. Do not assign 20–120 rooms as expected demand or propose the whole 237-room hotel; room nights, peak rooms and catering requirements remain unknown.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced venue: Agroscope Changins – Aula, Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon, Vaud, Switzerland. Territory: Nyon / La Côte, not central Geneva, Lausanne or French Pays de Gex. This is a research-site meeting venue, not a competing hotel. Announcement establishes a venue commitment, not evidence of a signed venue contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Internationally rotating, non-annual series: official website describes meetings every three to four years since 1991. Confirmed detailed editions include Bordeaux 2010, Vitoria-Gasteiz 2014, Corvallis 2017, Cremona 2022 and Nyon 2027. The retrospective host timeline labels France 2009 and Spain 2013; contemporary participant reports establish actual workshop dates in 2010 and 2014, used here instead. The observed 2022–2027 gap also means no rigid recurrence interval should be projected. No subsequent edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Pre-reservation pathway exists: official event website states “Deadline for booking pre-reserved hotel rooms: 31 March 2027” and “Fees, payment and accommodation details are available on the Practical Information page.” That linked page could not be retrieved. No edition-specific hotel names, block sizes, rates, booking agent, housing bureau or open RFP were verified. Every verified named 2027 hotel: none identified. Do not interpret this as absence of incumbent hotels or as open inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: Agroscope is the Swiss centre of excellence for agricultural research, affiliated with the Federal Office for Agriculture; the Confederation runs this research station. It is the named 2027 organizer and venue institution, not a commercial PCO/DMC. GDPM is a scientific workshop series with rotating institutional hosts; a separate legally constituted GDPM association or permanent hotel-procurement body was not established. Sciencesconf is the published registration interface, not evidence of a housing buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Existing pre-reserved rooms create an incumbent accommodation pathway, but incumbent hotel identities and contractual exclusivity are unknown. No sold-out hotels, unmet demand, overflow requirement or competitive rate gap was found. Inference: transport and convenience relative to unknown incumbent hotels must be tested before claiming YOTEL is competitive.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact info_gdpm27@agroscope.admin.ch now, before the published 31 March 2027 pre-reserved-room deadline. Request the accommodation coordinator and Practical Information document; ask for every incumbent hotel, block allocations/pickup, release terms, booking mechanism, exclusivity, forecast non-local attendees and permission to add a Founex option. Only after a positive response propose a demand-sized lodging allocation and costed Changins transport. Use Gindro or Dubuis as referral routes only, not asserted buyers; do not pitch relocation of the workshop.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 workshop is accessible as an organizer enquiry, not a verified available hotel contract. Venue is already announced and hotel pre-reservations exist, with a 31 March 2027 booking deadline. Official travel evidence: “Geneva International Airport (GVA) is located 25 km from Nyon, with direct trains to Nyon.” This supports airport-linked international access, not delegate flight bookings, lodging in Founex or a hotel shuttle commitment. The Lausanne/French-border travel-evidence condition is not applicable to this Nyon venue.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build an Agroscope relationship for future local scientific meetings and seek addition to the 2027 accommodation options only if the organizer confirms room demand and that additional hotels are permitted. Global rotation does not establish another Nyon edition, any later Swiss date, or future GDPM hotel sourcing. No future edition beyond 2027 should be sold as confirmed.
